deadline.value: Fall 2027: complete application and fee by February 28, 2027 for international applicants (domestic July 31, 2027).

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test exists for this field; McMaster Engineering does not require the GRE.

supervisor.value: You can apply without a supervisor, but a faculty member must agree to supervise you before you get an offer; contacting faculty helps.
supervisor.quote: you do not need to have a supervisor to apply for admission | a faculty member must be willing to act as your supervisor in order for you to receive an offer of admission

funding.value: Engineering guarantees full-time domestic and international PhD students at least CAD 21,000 plus tuition a year, usually for up to four years.
funding.quote: The Faculty of Engineering has a minimum funding package for full-time domestic and international Doctoral students | This minimum amount is $21,000 plus tuition

entry_route.value: A master's in a related field is required; bachelor's holders enrol at the master's level and the best may transfer to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Master's Degree (MAsc, MSc, or equivalent) in a related field. | Students holding a Bachelor's degree should enroll at the Master's level.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not considered for admission.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are NOT taken into consideration for admission.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 88 with 20 per section (new scale: 4.5 overall).
toefl_min.quote: Minimum overall score of 88 Minimum score of 20 for each section

english_waiver.value: Exempt if your previous institution taught in English, with an official letter or transcript stating this.
english_waiver.quote: If English is the language of instruction at your previous institution, you can be exempted from the ELP requirement by providing either: an official letter from your previous institution stating that the language of instruction is English; OR official transcripts which state that English is the language of instruction.

notes: 2026-27 example funding for an international PhD student was about CAD 31,300.
